create_lora_layer_wrapper: create a LoRA wrapper layer from a base PyTorch module using get_lora_layer
apply_lora_to_embedding: apply LoRA to vocab parallel embedding with efficient embedding lookup for tokens
apply_lora_to_lm_head: apply LoRA to parallel LM head layer with sharded B weights across tensor parallel ranks
apply_lora_to_moe_layer: apply LoRA to fused MoE layer with gate_up and down projection deltas integrated into computation
apply_lora_to_qkv_linear: apply LoRA to QKV parallel linear layer with separate shards for query, key, and value projections
